audience: People comparing a small made-to-order bicycle range; phone and desktop use.
request: Build a beautiful product page and compact configurator for a bicycle frame builder. Give the actual bicycle a strong visual role using original SVG illustration. Help someone understand and inspect their choices, with a clear honest local quote summary.

facts.name: Kite
facts.headline: Made for the long way home.
facts.description: A made-to-order steel bicycle for daily rides and unhurried weekends.
details: Built to order in small batches

required_behavior: Select frame size, colour and wheel option; labels and selected states must reflect those choices.
Colour choice changes the actual visible bicycle frame treatment; wheel choice updates the displayed total and summary accurately.
Open a local quote summary showing the current configuration and total. Clearly state no order or payment is created; allow a visible close and Escape.
constraints: Fictional offline demonstration. Do not invent availability, delivery deadlines, specifications, reviews or performance claims.
Use system font stacks and original SVG/CSS artwork. No external assets, libraries or requests.
Initial selection is an editable proposal, not a confirmed order.
